text_en: To the leader. Of David, for the memorial offering.
Be pleased, O God, to deliver me. O Lord , make haste to help me!
text_cn: 天主，求你快来救我， 上主，求你速来助我。

text_en: Let those be put to shame and confusion who seek my life. Let those be turned back and brought to dishonor who desire to hurt me.
text_cn: 愿那些图谋杀害我的人，受辱退去， 愿那些喜欢我遭难的人，含羞出走！

text_en: Let those who say, “Aha, Aha! ” turn back because of their shame.
text_cn: 愿那些向我哈哈戏笑的人， 个个满面羞惭而退去无影？

text_en: Let all who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let those who love your salvation say evermore, “God is great! ”
text_cn: 愿那些寻求你的人，都因你欢欣鼓舞， 愿恋慕你救恩的人，都常说：大哉天主！

text_en: But I am poor and needy; hasten to me, O God! You are my help and my deliverer; O Lord , do not delay!
text_cn: 天主，我实在卑微而又贫苦，求你速来救我； 上主，你是我的助佑和救援，求你不要延搁。
